result.summary: The main visual issue is a layout display error in the 'Popular right now' section where a promotional banner/card appears blank or broken, displaying only a pizza graphic without any text, title, or pricing information, unlike the restaurant card above it.

issues.description: The promotional card at the bottom of the screen contains a '-100%' badge but lacks all restaurant information, such as name, rating, delivery time, or delivery fee, making it appear as a broken or partially loaded element.
issues.suggestion: Verify that all data fields for the promotional card are being correctly fetched and displayed. Ensure the layout container is correctly populating the restaurant title, meta-information, and rating.
